title: Persistence delta selection and materialisation proportional to dirty sessions and delegations, not a full scan plus a linear find per tick
outcome: Persistence delta selection and materialisation proportional to dirty sessions and delegations, not a full scan plus a linear find per tick
acceptance: Persistence delta planning selects changed sessions and delegations through a dirty index, and materialises each by key, with no full scan of every session and delegation on each plan and no linear find per changed record. Per-tick work on an idle host is proportional to dirty records.
Unchanged, removed, racing and tail-trim semantics are preserved. A behavioural regression with a large history (thousands of sessions) and few changes asserts bounded work.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree that lands.
